title: Wavetechs Explosive Reaction Copper Farm
description:
In this video I introduce the Wavetech server and my very first project, an insane custom built copper farm which puts out 3500 copper ingots per hour. We'll also look at the mechanics behind the farm along with a much simpler general use design which anyone can use in their own game.
